data.description: This iron ring's head is shaped like a gilded anvil. In addition to the usual powers of a ring of ferocious action, the wearer can expend 1 charge from a ring of sundering metals to magically imbue a single wielded metal melee weapon with cold iron or silver. For 1 minute, the imbued weapon can bypass either DR/cold iron or DR/silver.
